item.text: {"answer":"2023–24: 2,208 LEAs were surveyed; 1,579 responses were recorded, stated as about 72%. The report also recalculated participation after excluding 385 LEAs that said they did not offer TK: 1,579 responses among the remaining 1,823 LEAs, stated as 87%. 2024–25: 1,464 LEAs were surveyed; 952 responses were recorded, stated as about 65%. The report additionally says that 926 of the remaining LEAs (95%) indicated they had at least one TK program; it does not label that 95% as the survey response rate. Thus, from 2023–24 to 2024–25, the survey covered 744 fewer LEAs, recorded 627 fewer responses, and the stated overall response rate fell by about 7 percentage points (72% to 65%).","citations":["anx://docx-41cb615d9e957e2e9276b1ed/revisions/0/blocks/paragraph-1379065c3d4c000e","anx://docx-6f412740022c92954507cac8/revisions/0/blocks/paragraph-282af7a00c79af70","anx://docx-6f412740022c92954507cac8/revisions/0/blocks/paragraph-f2c927f312cec6fd"],"confidence":0.99}
